name: Gai
source:
A hot-blooded boy called "Gai". His language is vulgar and he is violent beyond control.

​An unidentified existence that recognizes [url=https://vndb.org/c113347]Neeco[/url] and says, "There is no sign of Ikenie.".

[Translated from [url=https://romankessha.wixsite.com/sadisma]official website[/url]]
